info.name: YouTube Liquid Glass UI
info.description:
YOUTUBE LIQUID GLASS UI (YT + YT MUSIC)
Give YouTube and YouTube Music a clean, Apple-inspired frosted glass look. Built for daily use with smooth 3D floating menus, a custom 3D logo, clutter-free comment cards, and fast animations that will not slow down your browser.

WHAT YOU GET:
- Frosted Glass Design: Warm, clear glass cards, buttons, and a seamless top bar.
- 3D Floating Menus: Sidebars and popups tilt and glide smoothly when you hover over them.
- Cleaner Layout: 4 videos per row, a clean Shorts player, and replies grouped neatly inside one comment card.

BEFORE YOU INSTALL:
- Dark Mode Only: Make sure YouTube Dark Theme is turned on (Appearance > Dark theme).
- Turn Off Other Themes: Disable other YouTube themes so borders and cards do not overlap.
- Smooth Blur Tip: Keep "Graphics Acceleration" (or Hardware Acceleration) turned ON in your browser's System settings for the best glass effect.
info.additionalInfo: Note: This project is now in its final Beta stage and is stable for everyday use. Because YouTube updates its website layout all the time, you might occasionally spot a small visual bug. I update this theme regularly to keep everything working smoothly, so if anything looks off, just grab the latest update!
